body.content: Hypothesis: the adjudication-ritual's sustained flag is a two-gate AND condition: (1) at least one critic verdict finding failure exists, and (2) at least one NU (peer) verdict confirms that critic's verdict as sound and relevant. SRC_007 + SRC_006 satisfies gate (1)+(2) for frontier-claim-honest. SRC_009 + SRC_008 satisfies gate (1)+(2) for frontier-above-floor. Two parallel AND-conditions is sufficient for a ritual-level sustained flag under §11.3.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a precise structural mechanism testable against §11.3 wording if it is surfaced in context.
